Q1: Which stall-recovery paths should get the self-run check, the one-time live refetch and the "active set unverifiable" escalation hold? (The diagnostic line only prints from the tracking-issue stall block. Issues not managed by the orchestrator, possibly including binance-blessings #557/#559, are escalated by `run_standalone_stall_recovery`, which reads the same blob for each tick.)
Choices:
- A: Both paths. Run the check and refetch once per tick at the first stall consumer, so the refreshed blob is shared through the per-tick memo and the call budget stays at one extra live fetch. Apply the escalation hold in both `recover_stalled_issue` (tracking) and `run_standalone_stall_recovery` (RECOMMENDED)
- B: Only the tracking-issue stall block (after `build_active_issue_set` at around L33614), exactly as the Approach section says. The standalone path is unchanged; any follow-up there gets its own issue
- C: Only `run_standalone_stall_recovery`, on the view that it is the path that escalated #557/#559
